message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need to know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are earned by being the first to finish a round and by collecting the cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (1–9, two of each; 2× “Skip”, “Reverse”, “Draw Two”; 4× “Wild”, 4× “Wild Draw Four”). | | **Setup** | 1. Shuffle the deck.
2. Deal 7 cards to each player.
3. Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile.
4. Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two,” the first player draws two cards and loses their turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a “Reverse” changes direction). On your turn you may:
• **Play** one card that matches the color, number, or symbol of the top discard.
• **Play** a Wild card (any color) or Wild Draw Four (must be declared “Wild” if you’re not forced to draw).
• **Draw** one card from the draw pile if you cannot or choose not to play. If the drawn card can be played, you may play it immediately. | | **Special Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – You choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Must be played only when you have no matching color; otherwise you can be challenged.) | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your second‑to‑last card, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player calls it out, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards all their cards. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of the cards left in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Scoring & Game End** | Keep a running total. The first player to reach 500 points wins the game (or whatever target you agree on). | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep track of the current color** – Even if a Wild was played, the next player must match that color unless they play another Wild. 2. **Use “Draw Two” and “Wild Draw Four” strategically** – Save them for when you’re about to win or when you need to block a strong opponent. 3. **Watch for “UNO”** – It’s a simple but powerful rule that can cost you two cards if you slip up. Enjoy your game!
